brand_notes.fabric: brands.json's brand-level fabric string is 'Waxed cotton canvas / cotton-faced X11 laminate / occasional X-Pac RX30'. This matches all four maker pages exactly - Large and Small both offer waxed canvas and cotton-faced X11, with RX30 X-Pac called out on Small as an 'occasional' option, and Clap Trap's own colour list is waxed canvas plus two X11 colourways with no X-Pac. Photos confirm the two fabrics read very differently: the waxed-canvas colorways (large-1 olive, large-2 tan, small-1 olive, clap-trap-2 brown, clap-trap-3 olive) all show visible wax patina, mottled tonal variation, and a matte, slightly stiff drape; the technical colorways (small-2 lavender, small-3/mini-1/mini-2 'Black Tulip' floral print) show a smooth, flat, non-canvas laminate finish consistent with X11/X-Pac. Verdict: brand string is accurate for all four products.
brand_notes.method: Dimensions and material copy cross-checked against ronsbikes.com product pages via WebFetch. All 10 local photos in assets/products/ron-s-bikes/ were opened and reviewed. None of the four product pages publish a height figure or (for Large/Small) a litre figure - flagged per product below rather than guessed.

products.name: Fabio's Chest LARGE
products.dims_raw: main body 14.5" wide / total width (body and pockets) 20" / depth 9" / rackless recommended clearance between bottom of bars and top of tires 10.5"
products.dims_note: len (14.5in main body width, across the bars) and wid (9in depth) are the maker's own published figures - confirmed unchanged via WebFetch, no range given. NO HEIGHT AND NO LITRE FIGURE IS PUBLISHED AT ALL. hgt here is a visual estimate off the on-bike/studio photos (not back-computed from volume, since there is no volume to back-compute from): the barrel's front-on silhouette in photo 1 and the 3/4 on-bike view in photo 2 both read as roughly circular/oval end-on, i.e. depth and height look similar for this horseshoe-roll form, so hgt is set equal to the published 9in depth as the best available estimate. This is a genuine guess, not a measurement - verified is false and confidence is low. Total width including the loaded side pockets is 20in (50.8cm) if the wider footprint matters for clearance checks.

geometry.notes: Rolled horseshoe/barrel body with a flat front face carrying a triangular embroidered flower patch, bulging external side pockets each end. Photo 1 (olive waxed canvas, off-bike) and photo 2 (tan waxed canvas, on-bike 3/4 view) both show this same silhouette.

closure.hardware: 2 side-release buckles on webbing straps running front-to-back over the top of the roll, clearly visible in both photos

straps.notes: 2 straps over the top of the roll, cinching front to back, visible in both photos

pockets.notes: gathered/bellows-style side pockets, one with its own small buckle flap visible in photo 2 (tan, on-bike); maker's 20in 'total width' figure is with these pockets loaded

logo.notes: triangular patch, red flower motif on a cream ground in the olive/tan colorways

details.fabric: Waxed canvas (photographed colorway) - matches brand string; see brand_notes.fabric. Also offered in cotton-faced X11 laminate.

mount.notes: Rackless bar mount is primary; maker also lists compatible front/rear racks (Shovel Research Rod Steward, Nitto M1, Mica rear support, Velo Orange Constructeur) with rear use needing a dowel and Voile straps - not modelled here. clearance.tyre_mm (267mm/10.5in) is the maker's own RECOMMENDED MINIMUM bar-to-tyre clearance for rackless use, not a measured on-bike value.

products.name: Fabio's Chest SMALL
products.dims_raw: main body 10.5" wide / total width (body and pockets) 16" / depth 9" / rackless recommended clearance between bottom of bars and top of tires 10.5"
products.dims_note: len (10.5in main body width) and wid (9in depth, same as the Large) are the maker's own published figures, confirmed via WebFetch - no height and no litre figure published, same gap as the Large. hgt here is the same visual estimate approach as the Large (depth used as a stand-in for height on this round-ish horseshoe form, based on the on-bike photo silhouette), NOT back-computed from any volume figure since none exists. Genuine guess - verified false, confidence low.

geometry.notes: Same horseshoe/barrel silhouette as the Large, scaled down: rolled body, flat front face with the triangular flower patch, bulging side pockets. Visible across all 4 photos (olive waxed in photo 1, lavender X-Pac in photo 2, 'Black Tulip' print laminate in photo 3, tan waxed on-bike in photo 4).

closure.hardware: 2 buckled straps over the top of the roll, visible in all 4 photos

pockets.notes: gathered side pockets; maker's 16in 'total width' figure is with these loaded

details.fabric: Photographed in both fabric families: waxed canvas (photo 1, matte with visible tonal wax patina) and X11/X-Pac technical laminate (photos 2 and 3, smooth flat finish, including a 'Black Tulip' floral print) - matches brand string; see brand_notes.fabric

mount.notes: Rackless bar mount; maker also lists the same compatible rack systems as the Large. clearance.tyre_mm is the maker's recommended minimum, not a measured value.

products.name: Fabio's Chest MINI
products.dims_raw: Body is 10" wide, 12" with side pockets full. 7" in height and 6" wide from the side. 11 liters of roll top hard bodied carrying capacity.
products.dims_note: len uses 12in (30.5cm), the AS-MOUNTED width with the side pockets loaded, per the new unfurled rule - not the bare 10in body width. Photos 1 and 2 (both the 'Black Tulip' print, off-bike and on-a-rock studio shots) show the loaded side pockets as a substantial part of the silhouette, not trim, supporting the fuller figure. wid uses the 6in 'from the side' figure (15.2cm). hgt uses the published 7in (17.8cm) - the maker gives only one height figure with no range, so there is nothing to take a minimum of; this is the packed/rolled figure as photographed. The 11L capacity is stated directly by the maker and includes the extended roll, so it will not reconcile neatly against this box (30.5 x 15.2 x 17.8 = 8.25L) - that gap is the roll-top's expansion, not a dimension error.

render.basis: Photos 1 and 2 show the roll-top partially extended above the buckled straps, consistent with the published 7in figure being a packed-down (not maximally rolled) state; turn count estimated at 2 from the visible fold in photo 2.

geometry.notes: Same horseshoe/barrel form as the Large and Small, in the same 'Black Tulip' floral print laminate in both photos - a smaller, more rounded body with prominent bulging side pockets.

closure.hardware: 2 black plastic side-release buckles on straps over the top of the roll, plus a Fidlock shock-cord closure for 'basket mode' per maker copy (not distinguishable from the standard buckles in the photos)

straps.notes: split back buckles and adjustable flap per maker copy, visible as 2 straps over the roll in both photos

pockets.notes: loaded, bulging side pockets, clearly the dominant part of the silhouette in both photos

logo.notes: same triangular flower patch, in a grey colourway against the dark print

details.fabric: Photographed in the 'Black Tulip' print, an X11/X-Pac technical laminate - matches brand string (also offered in waxed canvas and plain X11/X-Pac colours per the colorway list)

mount.notes: Rackless bar mount; maker states it fits drop bars down to 42cm wide. Also has a 'basket mode' (roll-top folded in, no clips needed) for use in a front basket, but this is an alternate mode, not a requirement - the primary mount is bar-strapped, same as the Large/Small.

products.name: Fabio's Clap Trap
products.dims_raw: 10" at the bottom, 8.5" at the top, and 6.5" deep. this 3.7L hard bodied top opening reverse randoesque bag sack. 296g - 336g. made in Vermont USA
products.dims_note: Tapered trapezoid, quoted by bottom width (10in, the LARGER figure, used for len per the taper rule) and top width (8.5in). wid uses the 6.5in depth. NO HEIGHT IS PUBLISHED. A prior pass back-computed height from the stated 3.7L volume (about 9.4cm) - the spec explicitly forbids fabricating dimensions this way, so that figure is discarded. Instead hgt here is a visual estimate read off photo 2 (on-bike, brown waxed canvas): the mounted body reads roughly 70% as tall as its 10in bottom width, giving ~18cm. This is a genuine estimate, not a measurement or a volume back-calculation - verified is false and confidence is low.

geometry.notes: Rounded-drum trapezoid: wider at the bottom (10in) than the top (8.5in), 6.5in deep. All 4 photos show the same rounded-front silhouette with a drawcord-gathered bottom edge and side pockets bulging at the base. Maker copy notes the front flap is taller than the rear 'to prevent contents from shifting', so a single height figure is an approximation of an asymmetric front/rear profile either way.

closure.hardware: elastic drawcord that loops over the stem or tucks into a rear loop, per maker copy; visible gathered at the top in all 4 photos

straps.notes: two 9in Voile nano straps per maker copy, not clearly resolved in the photos (all are close-up product shots, not wide enough to show the strap run)

pockets.notes: gathered elastic side pockets at the base, visible in photos 1, 3, and 4; maker notes these are NOT waterproof

details.fabric: Waxed canvas (photographed in yellow/gold 'Goldilocks', brown/tan, olive, and black colorways across the 4 photos) - matches brand string; also offered in Grey Blue and Black X11

mount.notes: One-handed drawcord opening per maker copy; mounts via straps to the bars plus a head-tube dongle for stability, visible in photo 2 (on-bike).
